ITEM 4. CONTROLS AND PROCEDURES
Evaluation of Disclosure Controls and Procedures
Our disclosure controls and procedures are designed to ensure that information we are required to disclose in reports that we file or submit under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the  Exchange Act ), is recorded, processed, summarized, and reported within the time periods specified in SEC rules and forms, and that such information is accumulated and communicated to our management, including our Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer, as appropriate, to allow timely decisions regarding required disclosure.
Our management, with the participation and supervision of our Chief Executive Officer and our Chief Financial Officer, have evaluated the effectiveness of our disclosure controls and procedures (as defined in Rules 13a-15(e) and 15d-15(e) under the Exchange Act) as of the end of the period covered by this Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q. Based on such evaluation, our Chief

Changes in Internal Controls Over Financial Reporting
There were no changes in our internal control over financial reporting identified in connection with the evaluation required by Rule 13a-15(d) and 15d-15(d) of the Exchange Act that occurred during the period covered by this Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q that have materially affected, or are reasonably likely to materially affect, our internal control over financial reporting.
Inherent Limitations on the Effectiveness of Controls
The effectiveness of any system of internal control over financial reporting, including ours, is subject to inherent limitations, including the exercise of judgment in designing, implementing, operating, and evaluating the controls and procedures, and the inability to eliminate misconduct complete

第4項　統制及び手続

開示統制及び手続の評価

当社の開示統制及び手続は、1934年証券取引法（改正済み）に基づき提出する報告書に開示すべき情報を、SEC規則及び様式で定められた期間内に記録、処理、要約及び報告し、必要に応じて適時に開示判断を行うため、最高経営責任者及び最高財務責任者を含む経営陣に当該情報を集積・伝達することを目的として設計されている。

経営陣は、最高経営責任者及び最高財務責任者の参加・監督の下、202X年X月X日時点における開示統制及び手続（1934年証券取引法規則13a-15(e)及び15d-15(e)に定義）の有効性を評価した。当該評価に基づき、最高経営責任者及び最高財務責任者は、同日時点において、開示統制及び手続が設計及び運用において合理的な保証水準で有効であると判断した。

財務報告に係る内部統制の変更

当四半期報告書（Form 10-Q）の対象期間中に、1934年証券取引法規則13a-15(d)及び15d-15(d)に基づく評価の結果、財務報告に係る内部統制に重要な変更はなく、また、重要な影響を及ぼす、又は及ぼす可能性の高い変更も生じていない。

統制の有効性に関する固有の限界

財務報告に係る内部統制の有効性は、統制の設計・実施・運用・評価における判断の行使や、不正行為の完全排除が不可能であることなど、固有の限界に服する。
